title: Inbox to-do rules
footer: Enabled rules ask the configured Inbox model about matching items after triage. Empty source and kind lists match everything. Rules are off until you add one.
dry_run_hint: Record decisions without creating or changing to-dos.
empty: No rules yet. Add a rule to decide which Inbox items become to-dos.
load_failed: Could not load Inbox to-do rules: {error}
prompt_placeholder: For example: someone asks me to review, fix, or reply to something.
decisions_footer: The log keeps a short, bounded history of what each rule decided and why.
